description: One operating budget for one company in one fiscal year: what was budgeted per account and per KPI, what actually happened, and how far apart the two are. Nothing here is typed twice — refresh_budget fills the actual and variance columns from the general ledger and the KPI framework, and check_budget_variances is the same arithmetic a Compliance Alert is raised from.

fields.description: What this budget is called — 'FY2026 Operating Budget' or 'FY2026 Highland Block Budget'. Unique across the site, since it is also the docname: two budgets sharing a name would be two answers to 'which budget' with nothing telling them apart.
fields.label: Budget Name

fields.description: Draft is being built and is never refreshed or alerted on. Active is refreshed by the overnight sweep and its variance breaches reach the compliance calendar. Closed is a finished budget kept for the record — still readable, no longer refreshed.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: The company this budget belongs to. A general ledger belongs to one company, so a budget reading actuals off it does too.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: Which fiscal year this budget covers. refresh_budget reads GL movement from the fiscal year's start date through today (or its end date, whichever is sooner) as the year-to-date actual, compared against each line's full-year budgeted amount.
fields.label: Fiscal Year

fields.description: The last time refresh_budget filled in the actual and variance columns. Empty means this budget has never been refreshed and every actual/variance field below is a placeholder rather than a figure.
fields.label: Last Refreshed

fields.description: One row per general ledger account this budget tracks. refresh_budget fills in actual_amount, variance_amount and variance_pct; get_budget_variance_report reads them back without touching the ledger.
fields.label: Line Items

fields.description: One row per Financial KPI Definition this budget holds a target for — a debt service coverage covenant, a cost per bin ceiling. refresh_budget fills in actual_value and variance_pct from the KPI's own cached figure.
fields.label: KPI Targets

fields.description: Who built this budget and against what — last year's actuals, a lender's covenant, a planting plan. The question asked of a budget a year later is usually where the numbers came from.
fields.label: Notes

name: Budget
